summary.oneLiner: One of India's leading electrical and electronics (E&E) companies, among the top two players in wiring harnesses for two-wheelers and three-wheelers in India with a leadership position in EV 2W/3W wiring harnesses.
summary.business: Dhoot Transmission designs, engineers, manufactures and supplies critical wiring harnesses that integrate electronic sensors and controllers, switches, terminals, connectors, junction boxes, high-voltage interconnection systems and data cables, for both ICE and EV platforms. Its product lines are wiring harnesses, battery packs, sensors and electronic controllers, and automotive switches, sold mainly to 2W and 3W OEMs in India with a diversified presence extending into commercial vehicles, off-highway vehicles, and farming/industrial equipment.
